suno.estilo: Driving folk battle music for turn-based combat: urgent, tense, beautiful. Melancholic acoustic chamber folk for a dark fantasy game. Recorded live in a small stone chapel: natural medium reverb, warm close mics, organic human timing. Core ensemble: nylon-string guitar, lute, psaltery, low cello, wooden flute, small metal bells, singing bowls. Lead vocal: adult female mezzo-soprano, pure airy tone, light vibrato, invented language sung with Spanish and Latin vowels. Choir: small mixed chamber choir, soft and distant. Fast strummed guitar ostinato, lute, aggressive low cello riffs, psaltery runs, iron bells, flute countermelody. Frame drums, deep bass drum, tambourine, claps. Wordless vocalise on the main section; choir answers with short chants. D minor with Phrygian accents, 128 BPM, 4/4. Form: 4-bar intro, 32-bar main section, 8-bar break of psaltery and bowls only, main section, short ending.
